title: Cannon
blurb: Field artillery on the line. Sixty photographs, solved on the studio's Mac; the piece was segmented out of the grass in every view and the trainer was asked to render nothing outside it, so the grass never became needles. Trained on the studio's own GPU box.
subject: object

title: Cannon — Mesh
blurb: The same gun as Scaniverse's textured mesh — spoked wheels and carriage on a patch of shadowed grass.
subject: object

title: The Oak
blurb: A lone oak by the road, retrained from sixty-nine photographs with the tree and its ground segmented out of the sky in every frame. The canopy stays soft: the leaves moved between exposures, and no amount of processing fixes wind.
subject: place

title: Saguaro

title: Field Gun at the Research Library
blurb: A field gun on the lawn outside the Hulston Civil War Research Library, captured on an overcast day so the light falls evenly all the way round it. Every other gun in this collection was scanned in direct sun, lit hard on one side and lost in shadow on the other; this one reads from every angle. Scanned on the phone, cropped to the piece and its patch of grass.

title: The Gun on the Line
blurb: The field gun standing where the line once stood, lifted out of the wider battlefield scan and cropped to itself. The same phone capture that produced the Wilson's Creek scene, read as an object rather than as ground: the piece, its carriage and the grass it sits on, and nothing else.

title: The Cairn at Red Rock
blurb: A dry-stacked stone cairn on a red rock ledge, cropped out of the studio's flagship desert capture. Every course of stone is legible; the wider scene it came from stays in the gallery unchanged, because that one is the reference every pipeline number was measured against.
